tools.name: ls
tools.title: Read the screen
tools.description: Read the screen of the front app, or of the named app, and the actions it accepts. Read-only.

app.description: The app to read. Defaults to the front app.

layer.description: Which layer reads the screen: auto, the accessibility tree (ax) or pixels.

diff.description: Show only what changed since the last read.

tools.name: gate_check
tools.title: Check the gate
tools.description: Say whether the screen is open to an agent right now, and why not if it is not. Read-only.

action.description: check, wait, init, pre, post or show.

idle.description: How long nobody must have used the Mac.

maxMin.description: With wait: how many minutes to wait at most.

tools.name: doctor
tools.title: Check this Mac
tools.description: Report what this Mac has for hackamore and the next step if something is missing. Read-only.

tools.name: do
tools.title: Run one action on an app
tools.description: Run one action on an app on this Mac, which other people may see, and read the screen after it. A person says yes first.

action.description: The action to run, as ls lists it.

inputJson.description: The action's input as a JSON object.

app.description: The app to act on. Defaults to the front app.

idle.description: Refuse unless nobody has used the Mac for this many seconds.

record.description: Write the step to this file, for a journey.

diff.description: Show only what changed after the action.

_meta.ouro.bot/confirm: Run one action (click, set_value, type_text, press_key, menu, scroll, perform, open_app, activate) on an app and get the screen after it.

tools.name: batch
tools.title: Run many actions on an app
tools.description: Run a list of steps on an app on this Mac, which other people may see. A person says yes first.

steps.description: A JSON array of {action, input, until?, app?} steps.

app.description: The app to act on by default.

idle.description: Refuse unless nobody has used the Mac for this many seconds.

record.description: Write the steps to this file, for a journey.

diff.description: Show only what changed after the last step.

_meta.ouro.bot/confirm: Run many steps on an app in one call; the run stops at the first refusal or unmet check.

tools.name: journey
tools.title: Replay a recorded journey
tools.description: Replay a recorded journey of steps on an app on this Mac, which other people may see. A person says yes first.

file.description: A JSON file of recorded steps.

_meta.ouro.bot/confirm: Replay a journey recorded with --record as one batch.

tools.name: agent
tools.title: Look after the resident agent
tools.description: Say whether the resident Ouro Reins Agent is running; install and build change only this Mac, and grant needs a person at it.

from.description: With install: the folder to install from.

force.description: With install: replace what is installed.

developerId.description: With build: sign with a Developer ID certificate.

personHere.description: With grant: only with a person at the Mac.

tools.name: wire
tools.title: Serve one request for another Mac
tools.description: Serve one JSON request line from stdin for another Mac that drives this one with --via, which other people may see. A person says yes first.

_meta.ouro.bot/confirm: Serve one request: read a JSON line from stdin and print the reply line. This is what --via runs on the other Mac.
